title: EfficientRollout: System-Aware Self-Speculative Decoding for RL Rollouts
abstract: arXiv:2606.18967v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a representative post-training paradigm for large language models (LLMs), enabling strong reasoning and agentic capabilities. However, rollout generation remains a dominant latency bottleneck because autoregressive (AR) sampling decodes responses sequentially and a small number of long-tailed generations often determine completion time. Speculative decoding (SD) is a well-established technique for serving fixed LLMs that reduces latency by rapidly drafting tokens and accepting them through parallel verification while preserving the target-model distribution. translated_title: EfficientRollout：面向强化学习轨迹生成的系统感知自推测解码
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）已成为大语言模型（LLMs）代表性的后训练范式，赋予其强大的推理与智能体能力。然而，轨迹生成仍然是主要的延迟瓶颈，因为自回归（AR）采样需要顺序解码响应，且少量长尾生成往往决定了整体完成时间。推测解码（SD）是一种成熟的服务于固定LLM的技术，它通过快速起草token并经由并行验证加以接受来降低延迟，同时保持目标模型的输出分布。然而，其实际加速效果并不能直接迁移到RL的rollout生成中：(i) 不断演进的目标策略使任何固定的起草器与策略的输出分布日益不匹配；(ii) 在rollout解码过程中，活跃批次大小不断缩小，使解码从计算受限转向内存受限的模式，而在此模式下并行验证……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 提出EfficientRollout——一种系统感知的自推测解码方法，通过让模型以自身为起草器，并自适应RL rollout解码中因策略演化和批次缩小导致的计算/内存受限状态变化，在保持目标策略输出分布不变的前提下显著加速强化学习轨迹生成。
en_tdlr: EfficientRollout is a system-aware self-speculative decoding method that accelerates RL rollout generation by using the model itself as its drafter and adapting to policy evolution and shifting compute-/memory-bound regimes caused by shrinking batch sizes, while preserving the target policy's output distribution.
